met_analysis:
The Low Pressure area over central parts of Uttar Pradesh persisted over the same region at 1430 hrs IST of today, the 07th September 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 4.5 km above mean sea level.
The Monsoon trough at mean sea level continues to pass through Sri Ganganagar, Narnaul, centre of Low Pressure area over central parts of Uttar Pradesh, Dehri, Purulia, Digha and thence east-southeastwards towards Northeast Bay of Bengal.
The trough from south Gujarat to cyclonic circulation associated with Low Pressure area over central parts of Uttar Pradesh across Madhya Pradesh between 3.1 & 4.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a cyclonic circulation over Kashmir & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists. Another Western Disturbance as a trough in middle and upper tropospheric with its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 75°E to the north of Lat. 29°N persists.
The trough from south Telangana to Gulf of Mannar across Rayalaseema and Tamil Nadu at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Bihar & neighbourhood extending upto 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over west Assam & neighbourhoodat 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
